notes.title: Diluvion Resubmerged 1.3
notes.content:
Hello divers!
It's been a while, but over the past two years we've been taking bits of free time here and there to go back and improve this game where we can.

It's not perfect, but we've been able to resolve some of the major issues that were plaguing the Resubmerged edition, like quest breaks, save file issues, and inventory problems.


convert save file serialization to more stable format
 fix a ton of little UI bugs
 fix inventory overflow problem
 add controller mapping for Dualshock 2, 3 gamepads
 fix Xbox One gamepad recognition on Windows 10
 fix various quest breaks and missing quest assets
 enable 4:3 aspect ratio


We hope you enjoy diving back in to Diluvion! We have a Discord now if you'd like to chat with us, show your sub, or report an issue!

Thanks everyone, happy diving!

notes.title: Save File Issues
notes.content:
Hello there! 
Some players have had issues with data going missing from save files (items/gold disappearing, missing quests, etc), and if you're one of those players, this post is for you.  Although we've attempted numerous times, we've been unable to reproduce this issue, which leads me to believe it's system specific. (not dissing your computer)

If you're having this issue and would like to help resolve it
We have a new development build on Beta branch- switch to the dev build and it will produce extra info that we can use to squash this bug. The best way for us to identify and fix it is to have an output log from a play session where it happened. If you do see error messages on screen during save/load, please send us your output log from the play session in the forums.

Steps to access the dev build:
[olist]
In Steam, right click on Diluvion and select 'Properties'
In the properties window, select the  'BETAS' tab
In the dropdown, select 'beta'
In the 'LOCAL FILES' tab, click 'VERIFY INTEGRITY OF GAME FILES'
Confirm that the download begins
[/olist]

Accessing your output log

Make sure hidden folders are visible
Find the output log at 	C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Arachnid Games\Diluvion\output_log.txt

Thanks again for anyone who is able to help!

notes.title: FTL-like submarine game Diluvion gets Resubmerged update
notes.content: Last year Holly Nielsen reviewed Diluvion, a game about being captain of a submarine straight out of Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea, and said, "While the watery depths you explore are a 3D space, when switching to an interior view of the submarines or cities you come across, the 3D transforms into hand-painted 2D graphics. These areas are where the style of Diluvion comes into its own, and the inspiration of Jules Verne is fully felt."She had some criticisms, particularly for its checkpoints, but also for the UI. Players had plenty of feedback for indie studio Arachnid Games too, and so they spent another year working on an update which they're now ready to launch. Resubmerged is a free update that makes salvaging more dynamic, adds depth to the looting, crew management, and sub upgrading systems, has more ship customization, and "enhanced visuals, new graphics settings, a complete UI overhaul with improved quest tracking and waypoints, the ability to save anywhere, and revamped landmark, navigation and pathfinding systems."It's a significant upgrade, one that also includes "new side quests, artwork and music alongside a number of quality-of-life improvements." Check it out on Steam.

notes.title: Diluvion: Resubmerged Launches Today! (Windows)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm happy to announce that we're officially launching Diluvion: Resubmerged today at 10:00am PST!

Diluvion Resubmerged Trailer

What's New
Diluvion: Resubmerged is the result of the past year and a half of additional development we've done on Diluvion. We've done a complete overhaul of the salvaging system, UI, and ship upgrade system. There's also new side quests, improved enemy AI, improved navigation, and many more small quality of life fixes.

For Beta Testers (Important!)
We're doing a swaparoo; Resubmerged will now be on the default branch, and original Diluvion will be moved to staging branch. If you already have Resubmerged installed, make sure you opt out of beta to continue with Resubmerged updates.

Loading An Old Save
We do support loading a save file from the original Diluvion, however because the quest structures have changed, it's not recommended. If you do have a game in progress and would like to continue it without interruption, the original Diluvion is still on the staging branch. When you load an original save into Resubmerged, it creates a copy of the save file, so you won't lose the original game state.

Dev Livestream
I'll be doing a dev livestream and talking about new features while running through the main quest line! Come check it out on Good Sheperd's broadcast here!

Feedback
As always, we'll be taking feedback in the forums. Let us know if you run into issues, bugs, or just have general feedback. (also if you have good things to say about the game too, we like that!)

Localization
Resubmerged has new text, and the original launch languages (English, French, German, Polish, Russian) are supported. We added a new section in the settings for community localizations. These are partially complete, but we'll be updating them as we get new text from the community.

OSX Version
Today's launch is the Windows version, however the OSX version isn't far behind- we ran into a little snag that we have to get solved, but it should be ready in about one week.

Thank You and Enjoy!
Thanks to everyone in the community who discussed, tested, and helped us complete Resubmerged!

notes.title: Diluvion 1.2 Beta has Gamepad Controls, Name
notes.content:
Hello again fellow divers!

Gamepad Controls
The latest version of the Diluvion 1.2 beta has been uploaded to beta branch, and it includes gamepad controls. There's some handy new features in this version, such as being able to use the bumpers to cycle between characters & stations.

So far we've tested with Xbox One / 360 controllers, so if anyone has other controllers they'd like to test with, it would be much appreciated!

Also, we've decided to go with Diluvion: Resubmerged for the official name of 1.2 Thanks to Thuzar for the suggestion!


Localization
Since there's new text in this version of the game, we'll be posting a new localization doc soon for community translations of additional languages. Since there's a significant cost to localization we will only be localizing the original launch languages ourselves. However, we'll gladly implement any languages that the community is able to localize.

Full Changelist

gamepad implementation
'Ghost of Morgensonne' quest revisions
hidden UI is still interactible - fixed
an empty iron minnow gets placed in players ship inventory - fixed
banquet hall shouldnt finish until you speak to athena - fixed
objective marked [none] displays when undocking from fountain of honor - fixed
Charles Spirios quest - implemented
on pirate bounty, the 'destroy first group' objective gets marked as complete automatically - fixed
Steel Hammer - implemented
fix positioning of sailors in stations so they never overlap officers
The Connoiseur - implemented
Naglfar hazards revised
Landmarks not appearing on compass - fixed
Sonar Guild quest - implemented
when torpedo module is removed, torpedo ammo HUD shows bolt ammo - fixed
when torpedo module first activated, the torpedo HUD doesn't get instantiated - fixed
fix positioning of item descriptor in loot panel 
Added popup to explain Coolant tanks if you have no engine kits
Overdrive doesn't display "heating up" graphic after upgrade - fixed


Until next time!
-Leo

notes.title: Diluvion Beta: June Update
notes.content:
Hey there! It's been quite some time since our last announcement. We have a new update to the beta, and this is a big one!

The beta's main quest line is now complete from start to finish.

We've fleshed out the Abyssal Trench quite a bit, and there's a lot of new stuff to see there. 

Check out our update video here

We'd also like your input on what the full title should be: Right now it's between Diluvion: Accretion and  Diluvion: Sunken Grimoire. Let us know in the comments!

Changelist

Completed quest chain in Sunken Coast
Completed quest chain in Abyssal Trench
Items can be used in hazard battles while salvaging
Completely revised quest update HUD
Added 'Crew Overview', 'Sub Overview' panels to Captain's Tools
Fixed Sonar bug where signals were never decaying
Fixed bug where AI would use player's ammo 
Crew Exchange - crew can be placed on standby when swapping to a smaller ship
Fixed numerous small UI bugs
Revised munition effects
New scenes for forging an upgrade, swapping ships, upgrading chassis


What's Next
First on our todo list is to complete the script for the few remaining side quests so that we can begin full localization. While that's happening, we'll be working on gamepad implementation and general polish.

Thanks for reading, and we hope you enjoy the latest build. :)

notes.title: 1.2 Beta Updated with Save-Anywhere Feature
notes.content:
To all our players, thank you for sticking with us through this journey, and having patience with bugs and imbalance in the beta build. Your feedback not only helps us identify issues, but motivates us along the way.

To new players: there are effectively two versions of the game available. By default, you'll get the stable launch version. We identified some mechanics and features we want to change post-launch, so we created a newer version with the working title of 'Diluvion 1.2' (yes we're coming up with a better name). The new version is still in beta, but it's available to you if you're interested in being involved in the development process.

We've updated the beta with a much requested feature - as long as your sub isn't in immediate danger, you can save anywhere! We still have the 'save fish', which behave more like an autosave. 

Full Changeset (1.2)

Added option to save in pause menu
Added option to load file in pause menu
Reworked 'load file' panel
Fixed bug where speed would increase indefinitely when changing helm station's crew
Fixed soft freeze when quitting to menu
Added confirmation panel when quitting to menu or desktop
Fixed bug where camera would lock when swapping ships
Lots of small hazard balance tweaks
Balanced loot values in Sunken Coast


Known Issues (1.2) 
Torpedo targeting UI can be buggy
DLC ships will appear as an empty chassis - do not switch to this empty one
Some issues with the Lich hazards

notes.title: 1.2 Updated - Sunken Coast added
notes.content:
Hello there!

Diluvion 1.2 Beta has been updated with lots of goodies - we're now at version 1.2.16. If you're new to Diluvion, 1.2 is a version we've been working on to improve the game's core mechanics. You can find instructions for how to opt in here.

New stuff:

Sunken Coast added
New landmark system(Fjords Landmarks only - more coming soon)
Many many new sound effects
Re-factored loot panel, added 'swap' option
Officers will return upgrades now when leaving your crew
Sonar - Ping will reveal if a target is friendly or hostile, and will react to quest waypoints
Added keyboard navigation (arrow keys) to main menu, sub selection
Added weapon swapping HUD (press I or O to swap)



Bug fixes:

Fixed Home Base
Fixed inventory positions in Glaciem VI and Mariana subs
Dock icon properly displays when something's been docked to
Fixed - attempting to view interior while docked to an air capsule freezes game
Fixed text for pollen valley quest
Fixed 'Ice Cutaway' graphic
Fixed Kat's positioning in Bounty Jail
Save files now display correct information
Fixed loading music
Fixed - escape, re-enter battle with hazard breaks the hazard
Fixed - merchants restock during transaction with player


Known issues:

Performance slowly degrades over longer play sessions. We're still figuring this one out. As a temporary fix, exit and re-open after saving.
Bug with quitting to menu
DLC ships will not load. If you see a 'blank' sub (with no equipment) in ship selection scene, this is a result of the game mis-reading DLC data. Don't switch to it


What's Next
Our next development session will be focused on improving the feel of combat, and getting files from previous versions of the game to load without issue into 1.2. As always, we'll be fixing any major bugs that come up in the forum.

Thanks to everyone who's played the beta and given us feedback. We hope to hear more from you, happy diving!

notes.title: Diluvion 1.2 Beta Is Here (Read before downloading!)
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the very first beta of Diluvion 1.2 is ready to download!  

This version contains the Forgotten Fjords. It's highly recommended that you start a new game. Loading files from the previous version isn't yet supported, however it will be very soon. If you do decide to load a save file from the previous build, be sure to back it up first. 

To access, right click on Diluvion, go to Properties -> Betas -> Beta. You should see a download for 1.9GB begin. If it doesn't start, go to Properties -> Local Files ->Verify Integrity of Game Files.

This is our first beta for 1.2, so you likely will run into some bugs. If you want to help out your friendly neighborhood dev, please let us know in the forums if you run into a bug.

Release Notes

New Salvage engine
Explorables 2.0
New hazard combat engine
Revised crew movement mechanics
Revised submarine upgrade system
New UI
New main menu
New submarine selection scene
New quest system, waypoints
Revised torpedo aiming
Revised tutorial system
Revised interior artwork
Dynamic loading system to reduce processor overhead
New post processing effects
New aiming system


Known Issues

Crash when exiting to desktop
Some new controls may not work if you've already started playing on previous versions. If this happens, go to settings>controls>reset to defaults
If gamepad is plugged in while playing with mouse & keyboard, incorrect keymaps will show in tutorials
New language terms aren't yet localized. These will appear in [] brackets, or with [no loc] tags.
Gamepad controls aren't fully implemented


Moving Forward
Being the very first beta of 1.2, this is far from the release state. However, we'd love to hear your feedback on the new features. We'll continue releasing beta versions with bug fixes, more content, and balance tweaks. Thanks for being so patient and we hope you have a great time!

------Note------
If you return to version 1.17 after playing 1.2, there may be an issue where your 1.17 save files don't show up. This can be caused by newer save files confusing the old build. Simply browse to your save files at C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\LocalLow\Arachnid Games\Diluvion\SaveFiles and move any 1.2 save files from this folder to fix the problem.

notes.title: Happy Steam Summer Sale!!
notes.content:
Hey all, hope you're having a great summer so far. We're participating in the Summer Sale, and Diluvion is 50% off!

We've been getting some questions from newcomers about the state of the game; "Is it still buggy?" "Have they been updating/fixing it?" 

And this is good! That's what a discerning customer does. Just to set the record straight, we fixed most of the major issues within a week of release:

Checkpoint frequency
Controls
Camera settings

And some more in the following weeks...

Difficulty balance / enemy frequency
Linux support

For a more detailed view of what's been changed, you can find the full update log here.

We're also working on major mechanical changes and content expansion for version 1.2, which is expected to go into beta next month. You can find more info on what's in the works here.

Lastly, if you have a question or issue that hasn't been addressed, we're happy to help you out in the forums! Our dev team is only three members, so we can't guarantee the game will be completely bug free, but we'll do our best to answer your questions and fix any issues that come up.

Thanks for reading, and if you decide to give Diluvion a shot, happy diving!

notes.title: Update Schedule
notes.content:
While the majority of our resources are dedicated towards Diluvion 1.2 and the subsequent content patch, we still have plenty of changes scheduled until those big updates.

We might not have a new update every week, but when we do we'll be uploading it onto the beta branch on Fridays and leaving it up for at least 10 days in order to minimize bugs. Then, on Mondays, the update would become the live branch of the game.

We're constantly working to improve Diluvion. As always, we welcome and appreciate your feedback.

Good luck & have fun!

notes.title: Two Free New Destroyer-Class Ships, Steam Trading Cards and Additional Language Support Now Available
notes.content:
Attention Fellow Captains!  

We just wanted to inform you that two special new ships are now available in the game for the bravest of explorers to pilot.  We’ve heard your requests for additional larger classed ships, and we’re very happy to announce that today’s update adds the twin destroyer-class ships, Lun and Sul, to the game! Both ships can be accessed at the Spirios shipyard, and will be available to everyone as soon as the update has been installed.  

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/4e8f575efd624063b781d4adc0a1919c906623bf.jpg

Here’s the official announcement straight from the Spirios City Royal Dock offices: 

Citizens of all titles and stations gathered today at the Spirios City Royal docks as Duke Fenmire (first of his title) finally unveiled his much anticipated gift for Lord Charles Spirios’64th birthday celebration. The twin ships Lun and Sul, their hulls shining brightly in the reflection of the city lights, are due to take their maiden voyage on a patrol of the Sunken Coast.

Fenmire’s rise from common son of a minor to favoured noble of the Spirios household has long been the subject of much gossip, with some questioning exactly where his loyalties lie following his marriage to the daughter of a notoriously outspoken Dweller cleric. The Spirios Chronicle had the pleasure of talking to the Duke himself on his generous gift: 

“Sir Charles Spirios was the man who sent me on my journey of awakening. If he had not seen fit to send me to the Abyss, I would have never met my darling wife or come to know the true nature of our existence. I can only hope that by presenting Sir Charles with these humble gifts, made in the name of Sul, he who guided our worthy ancestors to salvation, and Lun, she who watches over and protects us, he too will come to know the Deeps' plan for us and act to save his own immortal soul. 

The fun doesn’t end with just these new ships though, as this update also adds support for Japanese and Hungarian languages to the game. To this end we want to extend a huge special thank you to Kengo700 and Lostprophet.hu for all of their incredible hard work and support in taking-on the monumental task of localizing the game into Japanese and Hungarian, and making their work available to everyone. You guys are beyond awesome, thank you! 

UPDATE APRIL 26: 
We also just added full Steam Trading Card support to the game. Happy Card Hunting! 

Other Updates: 
Everyone here is hard at work preparing a slew of new huge surprises beyond today’s update and we can’t wait to share more with all of you. Not only are we planning on adding more content to the game, but we’ve been closely listening to all of your feedback and we’ll be introducing several new improvements which will make exploring the secrets of the deep more enjoyable for everyone. 

This new content and improvements will be introduced in several upcoming updates, and we should have more to share soon. Please keep an eye out on this space for more information about upcoming updates.  In the meantime, we really hope that you enjoy the new ships and we can’t wait to hear what you think of them. 

Thanks again for sticking with us and for your continued support! 

Greetings, 

-Arachnid Team-

I can only hope that by presenting Sir Charles with these humble gifts, made in the name of Sul, he who guided our worthy ancestors to salvation, and Lun, she who watches over and protects us, he too will come to know the Deeps' plan for us and act to save his own immortal soul. 

The fun doesn’t end with just these new ships though, as this update also adds support for Japanese and Hungarian languages to the game. To this end we want to extend a huge special thank you to Kengo700 and Lostprophet.hu for all of their incredible hard work and support in taking-on the monumental task of localizing the game into Japanese and Hungarian, and making their work available to everyone. You guys are beyond awesome, thank you! 

UPDATE APRIL 26: 
We also just added full Steam Trading Card support to the game. Happy Card Hunting! 

Other Updates: 
Everyone here is hard at work preparing a slew of new huge surprises beyond today’s update and we can’t wait to share more with all of you. Not only are we planning on adding more content to the game, but we’ve been closely listening to all of your feedback and we’ll be introducing several new improvements which will make exploring the secrets of the deep more enjoyable for everyone. 

This new content and improvements will be introduced in several upcoming updates, and we should have more to share soon. Please keep an eye out on this space for more information about upcoming updates.  In the meantime, we really hope that you enjoy the new ships and we can’t wait to hear what you think of them. 

Thanks again for sticking with us and for your continued support! 

Greetings, 

-Arachnid Team-

notes.title: Save Backups, Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow divers, hope you are all having a great March.

We're now releasing the save backup system in the main branch for both PC and Mac. Special thanks for those who tested this in the beta branch. Papa bless.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/c3c357aee1097f557071a7528cea5ee72720e51d.jpg

We've talked about the backup system before, but just to refresh: This system creates a backup when you save if it's been more than 10 minutes since your last backup. The appear in the 'backups' folder inside the save file folder.
C:\Users\[username]\AppData\LocalLow\arachnid games\diluvion\savefiles

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/ad52818485762da4dcd7102472d8655baefa17b5.png

All you need to do to use a backup is drag it from the backups folder into the main save folder.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/ced1748bf56007c7de399f7ea729692be1126cd5.png

Other Updates

We're hard at work on the revisions to 1.2. We have a lot of great stuff coming, and we've been working on some core components as well that make it easier for us to create content, and a more stable game.

We also have a content update coming in April, but I don't want to spoil the surprise just yet.

For the updates beyond, here's a sneak peek at one of the new creatures we're working on. It's based on a humphead parrotfish, but these guys in particular can grow up to the size of a Beluga class sub.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/e9305a424fe9982d3ca45c8aea3d4a4ad0da3cd9.png


Thanks again everyone for sticking with us; it's been sick to read everyone's discussions and improve the game with the community. :) 

Cheers,
-Arachnid Team

notes.title: Save File Backups! (Beta)
notes.content:
Hey all!

First off, thanks for being one of the best communities we've ever worked with. It's been awesome to see all your feedback, and much of it we're working on implementing.

One thing that's been upsetting to us is that some folks are losing data on their save files. We're working on finding and nailing any areas where this can happen, but it seems to be happening almost at random to a small percentage of players, so it's taking us more time than we'd hoped to fix.

Because of this, we've introduced a save backup system, which is currently available in the beta branch. 

The way this works, is every time you save, if it's been more than 10 minutes, it will create another backup file. It should help to reduce data loss while we continue to smash them bugs.

Once you start using the system, the backups can be found here:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/ad52818485762da4dcd7102472d8655baefa17b5.png

And if data loss does occur, simply drag the most recent backup from the backups folder into the SaveFiles folder.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/ced1748bf56007c7de399f7ea729692be1126cd5.png

To help us test out this new system, just right click on Diluvion, go to properties, and opt into beta. 

Thanks again for being so patient with us. I hope this solution can alleviate some frustration while we make progress on eliminating data loss.

notes.title: Diluvion 1.16: Controls & Camera
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Excited to announce that version 1.16 is now live. This version introduces a new control scheme, simulator, which can be accessed from the settings menu. Of course, if you prefer the old control scheme that is still available as well; just go to pause -> settings to select it.

See video here for a quick overview of what's new!

Full changelog:

new control scheme
added camera distance slider
added camera offset / centering slider
fixed FOV slider saving
fixed mouse sensetivity issue
fixed 'crew members / items lost when ships swapped'
fixed DLC ship crush depth displays
[spoiler]balanced Yamato boss battle[/spoiler]
batching / performance updates
fixed quest display sizing issue
home base now fully refills air


Quick note: the updated text is only in English for now, but we're getting it localized asap.

And of course, we'll be answering questions in the forums. Happy sailing!ːsteamhappyː
